name: Outfit Inventory (Parachute)
description: When selected, press [$[action_equipment_use]] while falling to deploy the parachute. It will then open when you are falling fast enough. Press [$[action_equipment_secondary]] to close the parachute. This parachute is single-use once equipped but can be refolded by storing it in an outfit inventory unit.
shortDescription: An outfit inventory unit containing a single-use parachute.
